_doc: Agent registry. The dispatch layer (agents/_lib/dispatch.mjs) and the runtime (agents/_lib/runtime.mjs) read this file. Adding a new department = add one entry here + create agents/<name>/run/start.sh + add the per-agent env file at ~/.config/coreprt/agents/<name>.env. No code changes required. The hardcoded AGENTS=(...) array in coreprt-agent.sh is the only remaining hand-edit; that gap is tracked separately.

agents.name: fizz
agents.description: Fizz is the CorePrt fleet router. Default for unhandled scope and the catch-all `@fizz` trigger.

agents.name: bumble
agents.description: Bumble is the webrnds-default site builder. Routes for web/scope, frontend, landing-page, thecardyard.

agents.description: Goji is the ggcoder-minimax generalist. Routes for docs, research, and unhandled scope.
